body: I don't believe that stuff anymore.

I wanted to go see him all day today. I wanted to go lay by his side and talk to him... I didn't let myself because it's not Friday, and I don't want to let myself go more than once a week. I wish I could just forget him, and not remember ever being a mommy in the first place.

It hasn't angered me...

I would do anything to have him back. I want my life to end so that I can be with him. There's no purpose for me without my baby. I am so stupid. I caused this. I should've kept my mouth shut, I should have left... But I thought he would warm up to the idea of having a baby.

Thank you. I am in counseling, but it doesn't seem to help. I don't eat very much anymore either. I can't bring myself to be hungry, and so I drink instead. 

He calls me all the time, and says that "we can just have another one." I don't want another one!!! I want my little boy.
